prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption (hint, redesign), choose_path (copy, new_screen), finish (copy, incentive, layout, redesign), and sign_in (copy, hint, layout, reorder) changes, as each has only 1 test.
home new_flow and sign_in notification changes can be helpful, as tests in both categories produced significant wins.
adoption copy, choose_path layout, finish new_screen, and home wait_info changes consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
choose_path hint changes showed no clear effect or performed worse across multiple tests.
Most changes tested (24 out of 29) showed no clear effect or performed worse.
Predictions generally overestimated impact for changes with no clear effect, but underestimated the size of major winning redesigns.

Changes:
0: [home, new_flow] Desktop Dock Placement Assistant Flow: Adds an interactive screen positioning flow during generation that lets users test desktop window boundaries and anchor their pet dock position before launch. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop or app failing to open; home new_flow changes previously showed strong positive impact.)
1: [sign_in, notification] Cloud Sync Account Persistence Notification: Displays an active cloud persistence status notification badge on sign-in clarifying that logging in links desktop pets to the account across reinstalls. (why: 8 support emails mentioned pets missing or resetting after signing in; sign_in notifications have proven high potential in past tests.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Companion Interaction Mastery Flow: Adds an interactive practice sub-flow right after welcome to try out desktop pet commands like summoning, hiding, and chatting. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet, and finish step drops completion down to 74.9%.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Chime Notification: Triggers a audio chime notification when background rendering finishes during the waiting step. (why: Home waiting median time is 201s (mean 2336s), and home notification interventions are proven winners.)
4: [adoption, new_screen] Photo Source Validation Screen: Inserts a photo validation checklist screen prior to photo processing to verify lighting and pet photo clarity. (why: 3 support emails noted custom pet creation failures and visual rendering bugs during adoption.)
5: [finish, layout] Desktop Controls Dual-Pane Overview: Switches home_intro to a two-column layout presenting desktop overlay shortcuts next to the welcome message. (why: Addresses post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control/hide pets while optimizing the final 74.9% step.)

scores.note: home new_flow is a proven category with high confidence, though building a new flow has high cost.

Targets high drop-off finish step and email issues, but new interactive flow requires high effort.
Low cost chime notification targeting long home wait duration, though direct evidence is modest.
Addresses adoption issues but adding new screens historically shows poor or negligible lift.
